title: India Government Tenders Output
description: Public GeM tender records in the Dataset, with an optional saved-watchlist comparison report. CPPP extraction is unavailable.

results.title: Tender records
results.description: All clean tenders saved in this run, including unchanged bids when a watchlist is enabled. Dataset saving and tender-scraped charging still apply to every saved tender.

changes.title: GeM watchlist change summary
changes.description: GEM-CHANGES JSON in the run's default key-value store, available only when watchlistName is supplied. The first safe bounded result window initializes a baseline with no events. Later reports contain newly observed bids and evidenced material updates, or explain why comparison was withheld. Missing bids are never inferred to be removed or closed.
